Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The production of taxi by A in year Y1 is 20 percent more than production of taxi by B in year Y2.

II. The ratio of total production of taxi by A in year Y3 and Y4 to the total production of taxi by B in year Y5 and Y6 is 8 ∶ 19.
solution:
**Calculation**

From statement I.

The production of taxis by A in year Y1 = 800

The production of taxis by B in year Y2 = 1000

⇒ (1000 - 800)/1000 × 100

⇒ 20%&
